ca1.report.qualityDefects.lead: The non-conformances of the contracts: severity, state, due day, days overdue and reopenings.
ca1.report.obstacles.title: Obstacles
ca1.report.obstacles.lead: The obstacles linked to a contract: severity, state, due day, days overdue, escalation level and extensions.
ca1.report.auditFindings.title: Audit findings and recoveries
ca1.report.auditFindings.lead: The audit findings about the contracts in your scope: the amount recommended to recover, recovered, still to recover and the recommendations overdue.
ca1.report.performanceRating.title: Contract performance rating
ca1.report.performanceRating.lead: The score proposed from the data for each criterion, the proposed rating, the proposal sent to the contractor, its response day and the official evaluation.

ca1.report.contractHealth.lead: The red, amber or green of each contract by its worst indicator, the reason of the colour and the share of red contracts.

ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.name: Claimed money granted
ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.formul: sum(amount granted) / sum(amount claimed) x 100, over the claims that were decided
ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.numera: sum(amount granted of the decided claims; a rejected claim grants nothing)
ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.denomi: sum(amount claimed of the decided claims)
ca1.indicator.claimSettlementRate.nullPo: No figure when the denominator is zero; a claim that is open or withdrawn is left out of both sums, and a claim that states no amount is not a claim of zero
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.name: Open claims near or past their limitation day
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.formul: open claims whose limitation day is past or within the warning days / open claims that have a limitation day x 100
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.numera: open claims whose limitation day is past, or within the near days of the rule CONTRACT_CLAIM_LIMITATION
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.denomi: open claims that have a limitation day
ca1.indicator.claimLimitationRisk.nullPo: No figure when the denominator is zero; a claim with no limitation term is not judged and its row says so
ca1.indicator.defectClosureRate.name: Defects verified and closed
ca1.indicator.defectClosureRate.formula: defects verified or closed / defects recorded x 100
ca1.indicator.defectClosureRate.numerato: non-conformances whose state is verified or closed
ca1.indicator.defectClosureRate.nullPoli: No figure when the denominator is zero
ca1.indicator.defectOverdueRate.name: Open defects past their due day
ca1.indicator.defectOverdueRate.formula: open defects past their due day / open defects x 100
ca1.indicator.defectOverdueRate.numerato: open non-conformances whose due day is before the as-of day
ca1.indicator.defectOverdueRate.nullPoli: No figure when the denominator is zero; a defect that is verified or closed is not open and is left out of both counts
ca1.indicator.defectReopenRate.name: Defects reopened after closing
ca1.indicator.defectReopenRate.formula: defects reopened at least once / defects recorded x 100
ca1.indicator.defectReopenRate.numerator: non-conformances with a reopen count above zero
ca1.indicator.defectReopenRate.nullPolic: No figure when the denominator is zero
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.name: Open obstacles past their due day
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.formul: open obstacles past their due day / open obstacles x 100
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.numera: open issues linked to a contract whose due day is before the as-of day
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.denomi: open issues linked to a contract
ca1.indicator.obstacleOverdueRate.nullPo: No figure when the denominator is zero; a closed issue is left out, and an issue of the project that names no contract is not in this report
ca1.indicator.obstacleEscalationRate.for: open obstacles escalated above the first level / open obstacles x 100
ca1.indicator.obstacleEscalationRate.num: open issues linked to a contract whose escalation level is above zero
ca1.indicator.obstacleEscalationRate.den: open issues linked to a contract
ca1.indicator.obstacleEscalationRate.nul: No figure when the denominator is zero
ca1.indicator.auditRecoveryRate.name: Audit amounts recovered
ca1.indicator.auditRecoveryRate.formula: sum(recovered) / sum(amount recommended to recover) x 100, over the financial recommendations of the findings
ca1.indicator.auditRecoveryRate.nullPoli: No figure when the denominator is zero; a finding with no financial recommendation has no figure, which is not a recovery of zero
ca1.indicator.auditOverdueRecommendation: Audit recommendations past their due day
open recommendations past their due day / open recommendations x 100
open recommendations of the findings flagged overdue
No figure when the denominator is zero; a recommendation that is closed is not open
ca1.indicator.ratingCoverage.name: Contracts with a proposed rating
ca1.indicator.ratingCoverage.formula: contracts for which a score could be proposed / contracts that can be rated x 100
ca1.indicator.ratingCoverage.numerator: contracts whose criteria with data are enough, by the rule CONTRACT_PERFORMANCE_RATING, to propose an overall score
ca1.indicator.ratingCoverage.nullPolicy: No figure when the denominator is zero; a criterion with no data has no score and is never filled with zero
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.name: Contractors that answered a rating within the window
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.formula: responses recorded inside the response window / ratings notified whose window is over or answered x 100
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.numerat: proposals answered on or before their response day
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.denomin: proposals notified that were answered, or whose response day has passed
ca1.indicator.ratingResponseRate.nullPol: No figure when the denominator is zero; a proposal whose window is still running and has no answer is not judged
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.name: Contracts that are red
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.formula: contracts coloured red / contracts that could be coloured x 100; the colour is the worst of the indicators that apply
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.numerator: contracts whose worst indicator is red by the rule CONTRACT_HEALTH_RAG
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.denominat: contracts that have at least one indicator to judge
ca1.indicator.contractRedShare.nullPolic: No figure when the denominator is zero; a contract with no indicator to judge has no colour and is not counted as green
